cat > programs/task-ce27e4dc.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   v=grid[r][c]
   if v and (r,c) not in seen:
    q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
    while q:
     y,x=q.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
     for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
      if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==v and (yy,xx) not in seen: seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
    comps.append((v,pts))
 comps.sort(key=lambda z:max(x for y,x in z[1]),reverse=True)
 out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
 for v,pts in comps:
  d=0
  while all(x+d+1<w and out[y][x+d+1]==0 for y,x in pts): d+=1
  for y,x in pts: out[y][x+d]=v
 return out
PY
